results.headline: Trading Update
results.key_quote: Camellia's trading result for 2026 is expected to be weaker than previously anticipated
results.summary: Camellia has issued a trading update indicating results are below prior expectations. The company now forecasts a full-year trading loss of £3-5 million compared to a trading profit of £1.0 million in 2025. Revenue is expected to be £255-260 million versus £268 million in 2025. While efficiency improvements have been made, these are being outweighed by rising global energy, fuel, fertiliser and transportation costs, plus downturns in avocado and macadamia nut prices and lower crop yields. Though some businesses (Bangladesh, India, Eastern Kenya tea, Brazilian arable) are performing as expected or better, weaker results from Kakuzi, Malawi, South Africa and disappointing North Sea activity at AJT have more than offset these gains.

No performance metrics or comparison to expectations are provided in this announcement - it is purely an administrative notice regarding audit delays.

results.summary: This is an RNS announcement regarding a possible offer from Axis Capital Limited for Permanent TSB Group Holdings at €3.20 per share. The announcement describes Axis's request for due diligence information, institutional funding interest from a prospective investor, and an intended court hearing request for adjournment. However, this is explicitly not a firm offer announcement and contains no statement of actual financial results, performance metrics, or comparison to expectations. The announcement explicitly states there is no certainty an offer will be made and any offer remains subject to multiple conditions.
